title: Build a Custom Vault From Two Sets and One Rune

steps.intent: open the launcher, press Pick Vault on a Claude Bare row, choose Custom in the Rune Vault list and tick the First and Second sets
press Launch to start a session on that Custom vault, without sending a message
in Runes, press Modify, then Add Rune and add one single rune that is not in either set
press Done and check the view lists the runes from First, from Second and the single one I added
check the vault name the session shows is the new Custom vault, and that Lock still reads Lock
